$comment: One 1200x630 share banner (Open Graph + Twitter) per indexable page. Rendered by scripts/render-share-banners.mjs into public/og/<file>.png. pageMetadata() picks the banner by path. Keep words few and plain: a label, the page's own headline, one short line at most. Art keys: sticker-<name> (public/stickers), helper-<order|collector|credit|stock|brand|proof>, mimi.
